title: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe's birth chart
metaDescription: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 5.2° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The chart's headline is a sextile: Venus and Neptune within 0.2°, taste wired to imagination. The scheme reads a sextile as a door left unlocked. Useful, and entirely dependent on someone walking through it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 5.2° Virgo: the first decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Mercury. A earth sign, read here in its first face.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 25.9° Leo, Venus was at 26.4° Virgo, Mars was at 3.5° Capricorn. Read together: a mind that decides at speaking speed; taste for the substantial and the lasting; drive that grinds rather than flares.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — Venus sextile Neptune, 0.2° of separation. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, Venus opposition Jupiter at 0.4°, and Jupiter trine Neptune at 0.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto close a triangle of trines. The closed triangle is the scheme’s picture of flow — and its warning that flow, unspent, stays private. The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, three sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Venus in Virgo at 26.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Capricorn at 3.5° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Pisces at 26.0° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives water 5, earth 3, fire 1, air 1, and mutable 4, fixed 4, cardinal 2 across the modes. Water signs hold memory in the scheme, where nothing is quite finished and little is genuinely forgotten. Jupiter and Uranus were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 15.3° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 11.7°.
